name: Priya Patel

education.degree: M.S. in Artificial Intelligence & Data Science

projects.title: BioMed-RAG: Clinical Literature QA System
projects.description: Engineered a Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipeline parsing 15,000+ medical open-access papers. Benchmarked semantic search using dense embeddings (BioBERT) vs sparse BM25 retrieval, generating evidence-backed clinical summaries with LLaMA-3 fine-tuned with LoRA.
highlights: Achieved 87.4% ROUGE-L score on clinical QA benchmark, outperforming vanilla retrieval baseline by 22%.
Applied LoRA 4-bit quantization to run model inference within 8GB VRAM limits.

projects.title: Autonomous Drone Obstacle Avoidance using YOLOv8
projects.description: Trained real-time object detection models on synthetic and flight camera feeds to detect wires, trees, and obstacles at 45 FPS on edge NVIDIA Jetson.
highlights: Quantized model with INT8 TensorRT, achieving 3.2x latency reduction on edge hardware.

experience.description: Researched cross-lingual semantic representation transfer under Prof. Henderson. Published a workshop paper at EMNLP 2025.

strengths: Deep theoretical and mathematical foundation in deep learning and Transformers
Hands-on experience fine-tuning LLMs and building RAG pipelines
Publication track record and empirical evaluation rigor
growth_areas: Production software engineering practices (Kubernetes, high-throughput cloud streaming)
Frontend development and user dashboard creation
